Remote Invigilation & Proctoring Solutions for Australia
Compliant, Candidate-Friendly, and Locally Supported
Book a Demo
2500+ Global Recruiters in Amazing Companies Like These Use Talview
Australian universities, TAFEs, awarding bodies, and corporate training providers are increasingly moving to online exams but they need solutions that ensure exam integrity, local data privacy compliance, and a seamless candidate experience.
Talview’s Australia Remote Invigilation & Proctoring Solution
is designed specifically for the Australian market, combining local hosting, Australian-based proctors, and our patented Agentic AI technology to deliver secure, compliant, and scalable exam monitoring.
Why Australian Organisations Need a Local Solution
Australian institutions operate under strict privacy and compliance requirements. In addition to maintaining exam integrity, they must ensure:
Australian data residency
— Hosting and processing exam data within Australia.
Privacy Act 1988 compliance
— Including adherence to the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs).
Local candidate support
— With proctors and help desk teams familiar with the Australian education and professional training landscape.
Accessibility compliance
— Meeting WCAG 2.1 AA standards for candidates with disabilities.
Talview’s Australian Remote Invigilation Infrastructure
Local Data Hosting
All exam data is stored and processed in Australian data centres.
Redundant hosting ensures high availability and reliability.
No cross-border transfers unless explicitly approved by the client.
Australian-Based Proctoring Teams
Live invigilators based in Australia for real-time or post-exam review.
Understanding of local accents, cultural nuances, and candidate behaviour.
English-first service with capability to support candidates from diverse linguistic backgrounds.
Local Partnerships
Work with Australian resellers for procurement, contracting, and invoicing.
Australian-based professional services team for onboarding and custom integration.
Accessibility & Inclusivity
Compliance with Australian accessibility requirements for education and employment assessments.
Tools for candidates requiring assistive technologies.
Security and Compliance
Talview’s Australia Remote Invigilation is built to meet:
Privacy Act 1988 and Australian Privacy Principles (APPs)
Relevant state and territory data protection regulations
ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certification standards
How Talview Remote Invigilation Works
Candidate Authentication
AI-powered ID checks verify the candidate’s identity before the exam begins.
Secure Testing Environment
Talview Secure Browser prevents switching tabs, copying content, or accessing unauthorised applications.
Agentic AI Monitoring
Alvy, Talview’s patented AI proctor, detects suspicious behaviours and escalates to a local human invigilator when required.
Reporting & Compliance
Detailed logs and video recordings ensure audit-readiness.

FAQs: Remote Invigilation in Australia
Is Talview’s Australian Remote Invigilation compliant with the Privacy Act?
Yes, we store and process all candidate data within Australia, in full compliance with the Privacy Act 1988 and APPs.
Do you have Australian proctors?
Yes, we have live and review proctors based in Australia for exams in all time zones.
Can you integrate with Australian LMS and assessment platforms?
Yes, we integrate with platforms like Moodle, Blackboard, and Canvas, commonly used in Australian institutions.
Do you support accessibility requirements?
Yes, we meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards and support assistive technologies.
